# Suggest a change

English | [中文](https://github.com/ruokee/ruokee-agent-kit/issues/new?template=feature_request.zh.md)

Do not post credentials or sensitive vulnerability details in a public Issue.

## Problem

What problem do you want to solve? Name the affected component or document if you know it. If you are unsure, describe where you encountered the problem.

## Use case

Describe the situation or workflow in which you need this change.

## Desired outcome

What should you be able to do? You do not need to design an implementation.

## Current alternatives

Describe any existing solution or workaround you have used and its limits.
